## Use Nova Mono in VS Code

Paste this into your settings to set Nova Mono for the editor. The fallbacks are the same ones CodeFont writes.

{
  "editor.fontFamily": "'Nova Mono', 'JetBrains Mono', 'SF Mono', Monaco, 'Cascadia Code', 'Roboto Mono', monospace"
}

Copy

Nova Mono is available from Google Fonts.

[Google Fonts](https://fonts.google.com/specimen/Nova+Mono)

## About the Nova Mono coding font

A futuristic-style monospace font. Nova Mono is a free monospace coding font without programming ligatures.

Nova Mono is hosted on Google Fonts, so the specimen above renders without installing anything locally. It is one of the 95 families in the CodeFont catalog.

## Nova Mono FAQ

### Is Nova Mono free?

Yes. Nova Mono is free to use; check the official source for the exact licence terms.

### Does Nova Mono support ligatures?

No. Nova Mono has no programming ligatures, so sequences such as -> and != are drawn as separate characters.

### Where can I get Nova Mono?

Nova Mono is available from Google Fonts. The download links are listed in the Where to get section above.
